lead.body: The three leaders met in Shenzhen, issued a joint peace declaration, denounced nuclear war and pledged more talks on nuclear risks and energy security.
lead.headline: Trump, Xi and Putin meet in first three-way summit

stories.body: The UN's top court ruled Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya, a first verdict against a state.
stories.headline: UN court: Myanmar guilty of genocide

stories.body: An overnight strike hit the bridge's railway section, halting trains between Russia and Crimea.
stories.headline: Crimean Bridge hit for third time

stories.body: Anthropic jumped 17% in its Nasdaq debut, but the S&P 500 still fell 2.0% for a fifth straight loss.
stories.headline: Stocks slide despite Anthropic IPO

stories.body: Violence hit 28 districts as the Awami League's lockdown shut Bangladesh; Yunus's home was torched.
stories.headline: Yunus home torched in Bangladesh unrest
